## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Wéimójié suǒshuō jīng* (T475) is Kumārajīva's 鳩摩羅什 ([鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80)) classical three-fascicle translation of the *Vimalakīrti-nirdeśa-sūtra*, produced at Cháng'ān at Xiāoyáo Yuán 逍遙園 in 406 CE under the Yáo Qín. It is the canonical Chinese text of the *Vimalakīrti* and is one of the most influential single texts in East Asian Buddhist literature. The Taishō header cross-references Nos. 474 and 476 — Zhī Qiān's earlier and Xuánzàng's later translations.

**Abstract**

This is the canonical Chinese *Vimalakīrti* — the version cited, commented, and recited throughout pre-modern East Asian Buddhism. Kumārajīva's polished classical Chinese translation transformed Vimalakīrti from an obscure Mahāyāna text (in Zhī Qiān's [KR6i0075](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0075) form) into a literary masterpiece that reshaped Chinese intellectual culture: the lay-bodhisattva ideal, the doctrine of *bùèr* 不二 (non-duality), and the rhetoric of *upāya* (skillful means) all became central to medieval Chinese thought through this version.

Kumārajīva (344–413 CE) translated the text in 406 CE according to the *Chū sānzàng jì jí* (T2145) and Sēngzhào's preface. The text generated the largest commentarial corpus of any single Chinese Buddhist sūtra. Among the major commentaries: [僧肇](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E8%82%87) Sēngzhào's *Zhù Wéimójié jīng* ([KR6i0078](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0078) = T1775); [淨影慧遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E5%BD%B1%E6%85%A7%E9%81%A0) Jìngyǐng Huìyuǎn's *Wéimójié yìjì* ([KR6i0079](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0079) = T1776); [智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) Zhīyǐ's *Wéimójīng xuánshū* ([KR6i0080](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0080) = T1777) and *Wéimójīng lüèshū* ([KR6i0081](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0081) = T1778); [吉藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%90%89%E8%97%8F) Jízàng's *Jìngmíng xuánlùn* ([KR6i0083](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0083) = T1780) and *Wéimójīng yìshū* ([KR6i0084](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0084) = T1781); [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) Kuījī's *Shuō wúgòuchēng jīng shū* ([KR6i0085](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0085) = T1782); and many more.
